AUTHOR: Prior, JH; Campbell, MD; Dawkins, M; Mickle, PF; Moorhead, RJ; Alaba, SY; Shah, CRJB; Salisbury, JR; Rademacher, KR; Felts, AP; Wallace, F
TITLE: Estimating precision and accuracy of automated video post-processing: A step towards implementation of AI/ML for optics-based fish sampling
REGION: Gulf of Mexico shelf, west of Mississippi River Delta (GFISHER/SEAMAP Reef Fish Video survey), USA
SPECIES: Gulf of Mexico reef fishes (snapper-grouper complex); 23 species evaluated, e.g., Red Snapper Lutjanus campechanus
DATA: GFISHER/SEAMAP-RFV survey video: training from 2018-2019 surveys (603,533 annotations), evaluation on 315 25-min videos from 2021 survey vs manual MaxN for 280 stations
V_EV: Discussion: 'These false-positives were common in model 2.3 and were often associated with clouds of turbidity (Figure 9), debris, parts of the camera array'
D2: Train: frames/annotations from 2018-2019 surveys; test: 315 whole videos from 2021 survey
D_EV: Sec. 2.1/2.3: 'initial image library with 61.5k frame extractions from 2018 and 2019 surveys'; 'Automated counts from 315, 25-minute, videos from the 2021 GFISHER combined survey'
R_EV: Sec. 2.3: 'Automated counts from 315, 25-minute, videos from the 2021 GFISHER combined survey were generated' (training from 2018-2019); in-domain only as mAP50 79% (supplementary), not comparable metric
C_EV: Sec. 2.3: 'Automated counts at the model confidence thresholds (CTs) of 0.1... 0.95 were used to filter VIAME output'; 'ratios of false-positive and false-negative detections'
E_EV: Fig. 6: 'Linear regression is VIAME MaxN = Validation Set MaxN *(0.7) + 1 with r2 of 0.9439'
ARCH: VIAME: Cascade Faster R-CNN fish detector/tracker (motion and single-frame variants) + ResNeXt101/ResNet50 classifiers
METR: Percent exact count agreement, % within 1-2 counts, station-level false-positive/false-negative ratio, CV, r2/slope vs manual MaxN; mAP50 (supplementary)
NOTE: Different survey year (2021 vs 2018-2019 training) of same programme coded external under 계절/시기 per final rule. R3=N because in-domain performance is only mAP50 (supplementary) and external is count agreement; no like-for-like numerical change (verifier may argue R3=Y). C5 coded 검증 표본 오탐률: station-level false-positive ratio measured against manually reviewed validation set. ENV: 'reef structures along the shelf of the Gulf of Mexico' coded 산호초 (hard-bottom reefs; check). Manual MaxN from same videos -> same-footage reference.
